tasks.label: setup: link LSP libraries (.lib)
tasks.detail: One-time setup: junctions SMODS in, extracts the game code, clones love2d type defs into .lib\; then restart the Lua language server.

tasks.label: deploy: link mod into %AppData%/Balatro/Mods
tasks.detail: One-time setup: junctions the repo (the mod folder) into %AppData%\Balatro\Mods for edit-in-place development.

tasks.label: logs: open lovely log folder
tasks.detail: Opens the Lovely/SMODS log folder; open the newest lovely-*.log in VS Code to tail it.
